title: Aloha Spirits brewery liquor license and zoning limits
summary: The commission accepted the Aloha Spirits Brewing and Distilling liquor license application on September 9, but staff said the Planning Department has raised new zoning questions about the applicant's planned uses. The department is awaiting written confirmation of what the brewery may do at its location, and zoning may not allow selling kegs or cases to stores, restaurants or bars. No license will be issued until the zoning clearance requirement is met.
